text:
Recent News About Ball State University Athletic Department
View More
-
Ruthberg Named MAC Gymnast Of The WeekAfter turning in a pair of solid all-around performances last weekend, Ball State junior Hannah Ruthberg has been named the Mid-American Conference Gymnast of the Week.
-
WBB Ends Regular Season with Win at Miami; Heads to MAC Tourney Next Week as the No. 3 SeedThe Ball State women's basketball team ended the 2023 regular season on a high note earning a 77-68 victory on the road at rival Miami Saturday afternoon in Millett Hall.
-
WBB Falls to Bowling Green in MAC Tourney SemifinalsThe Ball State women's basketball team turned in an all-around strong performance but ultimately was unable to move past second-seeded Bowling Green, losing the contest 70-61 Friday afternoon in the semifinal round of the 2023 Mid-American Conference Tournament in Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse.
-
Diving Into The NCAA Zone C Diving ChampionshipsFour of Ball State's divers return to action Thursday and Friday when they compete at the NCAA Zone C Diving Championships hosted by Indiana at the Counsilman-Billingsley Aquatic Center.
-
Charity Griffith Qualifies for 2023 NCAA Indoor T&F ChampionshipsBall State track and field's Charity Griffith has qualified to compete at the 2023 NCAA Indoor Track and Field Championships, announced by the NCAA. Griffith will compete in the high jump and the pentathlon.
-
10 Straight; Gymnastics Tops Kent StateThe Ball State gymnastics program used strong performances on floor and vault to earn a hard-fought 196.125-195.725 victory over Kent State Sunday afternoon in a Mid-American Conference dual at the M.A.C. Center.
-
Cardinals Voted to Finish First in MAC Preseason Coaches’ PollThe Mid-American Conference announced its annual Preseason Coaches' Poll on Wednesday.
-
Wyatt Blake Named Men's MAC Diver of the WeekBall State senior Wyatt Blake has been named the Mid-American Conference Men's Diver of the Week after his performance at the Miami Aquatic Center last weekend.
-
Weekend Results: S&D at Ohio State Winter Classic / Miami ClassicWeekend Results: S&D at Ohio State Winter Classic / Miami Classic
-
Driscoll, Boyd Lead Cardinals on Day One of Falcon Florida ClassicJasmine Driscoll and Madelin Boyd led the Ball State women's golf team on day one of the Falcon Florida Classic on Monday
-
Men’s Tennis Earns 5-2 Victory Over In-State Rival ButlerThe Ball State men's tennis team (3-2) earned an impressive 5-2 victory over in-state rival Butler (5-5) Friday afternoon at the Northwest YMCA Tennis Center.
-
Hannah Ruthberg; MAC Gymnast of the WeekAfter turning in her best all-around performance of the season at last Sunday's Ball State Quad, junior Hannah Ruthberg has been named the Mid-American Conference Gymnast of the Week.
-
No. 8 Men’s Volleyball Suffers 3-1 Setback to No. 11 BYUThe eighth-ranked Ball State men's volleyball team dropped a tightly contested 3-1 match to No. 11 BYU Thursday night in Worthen Arena.
-
WBB Defends its Home Court; Stays Undefeated in Worthen Arena with Win Over AkronThe Ball State women's basketball team (15-4, 6-1 MAC) remained undefeated at home (10-0) in Worthen Arena after an impressive 89-66 victory over Akron (13-5, 4-3 MAC) in midweek MACtion Wednesday night.
-
Ball State, Eastern Michigan Selected For TelevisionThe Mid-American Conference announced today that two additional MAC contests have been added to the men's basketball television package.
-
T&F Continues Indoor Season at Hawkeye InvitationalAfter a strong start to the 2022-23 season at the Tom Wright Open on Dec. 10, the Cardinals look to maintain their momentum heading into their second meet. Ball State is set to compete at the Hawkeye Invitational on Saturday.
-
Gymnastics Opens Season With Strong Showing at No. 2 FloridaThe Ball State gymnastics team opened the 2023 season with a solid showing Friday evening, tallying a team score of 194.100 in a quad meet hosted by No. 2 Florida at Exactech Arena at the Stephen C. O'Connell Center.
-
Coleman, Jacobs Both Score Over 20 as Cardinals Extend Winning Streak to Six GamesThe Ball State men's basketball team extended its winning streak to six games after a 90-83 road victory against Toledo on Tuesday. Jarron Coleman and Demarius Jacobs both finished the game with over 20 points.
